title: This portfolio
summary: Multi-page React site with pre-rendered routes, animations, JSON-driven content and a contact form that lands in my inbox.
headline: This site: a portfolio built like a product
intro: Version 2 of my portfolio. Every page is pre-rendered, every word and image comes from validated JSON, and the whole thing is built from reusable components.

items.title: Content as data
items.text: Projects, roles, stats and copy live in JSON files validated with Zod. A new project is a new file, not new code.

items.title: Pre-rendered pages
items.text: Every route is rendered to HTML at build time, so pages load fast and share with their own previews.

items.title: Accessible motion
items.text: Animations respect reduced-motion settings; keyboard focus is always visible.

items.title: Tested
items.text: Unit tests for the content, end-to-end tests for every route, and CI on every pull request.
